linesContent.text: Scoring 35% of the Base Magazine Capacity as Precision Hits grants 25% increased damage for 11 seconds.
Stowing or Reloading the weapon resets the Precision Hit counter. The buff remains active while stowed.
Does not buff the Splash/Explosive damage elements of other perks.

localPolicies.counter: Consume each threshold: counter becomes zero; each next full threshold refreshes a 220-tick deadline. No refresh from every single hit.
localPolicies.stowReload: Clear partial counter while retaining the original deadline; time continues while stowed. Do not pause or extend on stow/reload.
localPolicies.nonPrecision: Misses/body hits do not increment or clear progress; no same-target or inter-hit timeout requirement. Pinned sources list only reload/stow resets; additional reset boundaries are master policy.
localPolicies.ammo: Use immutable official base magazine, not current rounds, overflow or perk-refilled ammunition. Current W46 values equal all three official base values.
localPolicies.damage: Master applies the buff only to paid direct weapon damage; separate payload splash tokenNONE and Dragonfly generic damage stay unchanged.
localPolicies.orderingLifecycle: Master owns threshold-causing shot ordering, token deduplication, expiry edge, cancellation, selection changes, death/logout/session cleanup and combinations.

unresolved: No current authoritative source located that explicitly specifies counter consumption on activation, repeated-threshold refresh or stow timer progression. Those precise implementation rules remain local policy with historical corroboration.
